purpose: W2-D foundation: implement fact-level progressive trust, separate trade permission from verification, and append immutable TradeRiskAcknowledgement evidence without creating a parallel Deal, Inventory or compliance engine.
authorization: Owner instruction on 2026-09-05 to continue the supplied PC-CROP post-registration specification with existing push/PR/merge authorization. Implementation remains blocked until this finite scope is independently accepted and promoted into immutable base-state authority.

excludedAfterSourceAudit.reason: W2-D stores its authority in a dedicated trade_trust PostgreSQL schema and uses the established raw-SQL/RLS transaction boundary. No new public Prisma model is required, so the canonical public datamodel remains unchanged.

W2-D first acceptance is an independent trust authority. Auction already exposes DECLARED/PUBLIC_ALLOWED from W2-B; consumer projection belongs to a later integration slice and must not widen this foundation.
Deal-stage consumption overlaps W2-C. W2-D foundation stores and validates trust/acknowledgement evidence against canonical references without modifying Deal creation.
Global CI remains an independent gate; the bounded trust workflow may invoke existing commands but must not weaken global CI to admit this slice.
The generic migration checker discovers additive migrations dynamically and must remain unchanged.

requiredInvariants: Verification is fact-level, not one global verified boolean. The canonical dimensions are EXISTENCE, QUANTITY, QUALITY, LOCATION, CUSTODY, OWNERSHIP_OR_DISPOSAL_RIGHT, ENCUMBRANCE, FGIS_STATUS, DOCUMENT_STATUS and REGULATORY_STATUS.

VerificationStatus supports exactly the specification vocabulary DECLARED, DOCUMENTS_PROVIDED, PARTIALLY_VERIFIED, VERIFIED, STALE, UNDER_REVIEW and CONFLICT_DETECTED; transitions are server-derived from durable evidence and versioned policy, never caller-declared authority.

TradePermission, VerificationStatus, RegulatoryStatus, SettlementEligibility, ServiceEligibility and RiskLevel are persisted/evaluated as independent axes. DECLARED + PUBLIC_ALLOWED remains valid unless a separately evidenced mandatory legal/regulatory blocker applies.

All W2-D authority tables/functions live in a dedicated trade_trust schema with ENABLE + FORCE RLS or an equivalently confined memberless command owner; application repositories use raw SQL through RlsTransactionService. No public Prisma model or writable session claim becomes trust authority.
Manual, ERP or document-assisted claims never create independent verification, custody, ownership/disposal right, FGIS success or regulatory compliance by label alone.

TradeRiskAcknowledgement is append-only and immutable. Each accepted record retains dealId, lotId, organizationId, userId, riskCode, riskDisclosureVersion, evidenceSnapshotVersion, warningShownAt and acceptedAt, plus the critical stage needed to prove repeated warnings.

Warnings can be required again at later critical stages; an earlier acknowledgement cannot silently satisfy a newer disclosure version, newer evidence snapshot, changed risk code or later mandatory stage.

Current user, membership, organization and tenant authority are resolved from PostgreSQL before acknowledgement and before replay. Revoked authority cannot replay an old acknowledgement as a current authorization fact.

Acknowledging risk records informed acceptance only. It cannot override a hard regulatory blocker, manufacture independent evidence, change quantity, release money, sign a document or authorize another organization.

Trust snapshots, acknowledgement, audit and outbox evidence commit atomically with payload-bound idempotency, CAS/version checks and tenant/organization FORCE RLS. Restricted application roles cannot bypass the command boundary by direct DML.

Existing Auction Inventory binding remains DECLARED/PUBLIC_ALLOWED with source_verified_at NULL. W2-D references that state as input evidence but does not modify W2-B reservation, bid, award or FGIS quarantine controls.

Existing canonical Deal, Inventory, Service Marketplace, Commercial Rules and Source-of-Truth utilities are reused as references/evidence. Do not create DealV2, InventoryV2, ComplianceV2 or another provider engine.
Registration, Role Eligibility, Federal Accounting lock #4321, package/lockfiles, external provider claims and production topology remain unchanged.
acceptance: Restricted PostgreSQL tests prove the ten fact dimensions, all seven verification statuses, independent axes and DECLARED + PUBLIC_ALLOWED without a fabricated verified timestamp or external success claim.

Dedicated-schema confinement is proven: no runtime role owns the trust tables/functions, PUBLIC cannot mutate them, FORCE RLS/current identity checks apply, and no public Prisma schema drift is introduced.

Same-tenant outsiders and cross-tenant callers cannot read or mutate private trust snapshots or acknowledgements; current membership/user/organization revocation is rechecked before command and replay.
Exact replay returns the original immutable receipt; changed disclosure version, evidence snapshot, stage, risk code or payload under the same idempotency key is rejected.
A stale/conflicting evidence update changes only the affected fact and derived axes according to a pinned policy version; it does not erase prior snapshots or acknowledgements.
Hard regulatory blockers remain blocked even after acknowledgement, while absence of independent verification alone does not block PUBLIC_ALLOWED trading.
Audit/outbox/evidence insertion failure rolls back the command with no acknowledged partial trust state.

The trust API returns only server-derived trust state and rejects client-supplied verification/permission authority fields; canonical lot/deal identifiers are validated as existing same-tenant references where required.
Forward migrations, zero public-schema drift, backup/restore, cryptographic freshness and exact-head CI/review pass without changing registration or global independent gates.
remainingTerminalBoundary: Auction/Deal consumer wiring, full UI disclosure/confirmation ceremony, repeated warnings on every required critical screen and real-user acceptance remain later integration/UX work.
Independent lab/surveyor/elevator/FGIS evidence producers and freshness/conflict reconciliation remain separate provider/regulatory slices.
Settlement and service eligibility must be consumed by their respective canonical engines before terminal end-to-end credit.
Verified REG.RU runtime acceptance remains required before any of the three terminal criteria receives PASS credit.
